title: Related table on a record page offers 导出 to a reader who may not export, and the click ends in an English error
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「等我决定的都要立卡，并且从业务的角度给我具体解释和我沟通」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat on `main` `63b86b385d`, on the example CRM unless noted. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## Business reason

A rep opens a customer's 商机 tab, sees 导出 and clicks it. A red English line appears: "Export is not permitted on object 'crm_opportunity' for this user". The list page hides the same button for the same reader, so the product says two different things about one permission. The reader learns they cannot export only after trying, in a language they did not choose.

## Measured

- Dev admin on the CRM: `/auth/me/permissions` gives `crm_opportunity` no `export` in `apiOperations`. The opportunity list page shows no 导出.
- `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_account/record/{id}?related=crm_opportunity.account` shows 导出. A click sent `GET /api/v1/data/crm_opportunity/export…` → 403, and the table showed that English sentence.

## Code readings

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:2399-2402`: `exportPermitted` reads `effectiveApiOps.includes('export')`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx:3409-3410`: `exportable` asks only whether the data source can export and the relation is known. `:3517`: the button draws on that.

## Acceptance

1. The related table asks the same question as the list page. A reader without export sees no button.
2. A reader with export still exports only the rows of this relation.
3. An export refusal that does reach the reader, in any door, reads in the Console's language.
4. A test pins both readers.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "const exportable = typeof" origin/main -- ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`
